sections.skill: Recognize burnout signs and plan a sustainable pace

questions.prompt: What is burnout?

choices.text: A marketing strategy for fast growth
A kitchen fire in the shop
A tax penalty for late filing

questions.intro: Owners often work long hours without breaks, which can lead to BURNOUT: exhaustion, mistakes and loss of motivation. A burned-out owner is a risk to the business. A SUSTAINABLE PACE means planning work hours the owner can keep up, protecting sleep and days off, saying no to work that does not fit, raising prices when demand exceeds capacity, and getting help. Watch warning signs such as constant tiredness, more mistakes, and dreading work, and act early.

questions.prompt: What recharges the owner?
questions.intro: A phone works well when charged, but if you never charge it, it slows down and shuts off at the worst moment. An owner is like that battery: work drains energy, and rest recharges it. Running on 1 percent all the time leads to mistakes and sudden shutdowns. Planning regular charging is not laziness; it keeps the phone, and the business, working.
